uniqueness: Globally unique native primary GUID: document ID equals UUID-v4 uploadId; draft ID equals persistent draft UUID. No secondary uniqueness inferred from paths or names.
existingWorkspacePrivilegePrerequisite: AppendTo at the already authorized workspace; inspect existing table privilege and effective record rights. Any missing privilege is a separate minimal reviewed proposal.
readerPrivileges: None on both new tables. Existing report-only workspace access must not implicitly grant table privileges, raw documents or drafts.

guard.registrationRequirement: Inspect SDK message-filter availability per new standard table; every supported mutation must be guarded or demonstrably unavailable. No skipped unsupported-registration error may count as success.

liveGates: Validate entity and relationship metadata constraints before creation; ownership is not a later mutable setting.
Prove Board-created and Schreiber-created child row access under the shared parent with actual Basic privileges and both callers.
Verify direct table reads are bounded by actual row ownership/sharing, including foreign workspace rows and report-only user denial.
Prove inherited rights after Reparent/Share/Unshare; cleanup may be asynchronous. Do not repair ACLs automatically.
Prove synchronous custom API ambient transaction and CAS behavior. Guard permits only exact source shapes; unexpected platform decoration fails closed.
Confirm backup owner inventory includes rows from both editors; caller-visible security trimming is not proof of complete inventory.
